name: SN2
description: Backside attack with simultaneous leaving-group departure; inversion at the reacting center.

name: E2
description: Concerted beta-hydrogen abstraction and leaving-group departure.

name: Hydride Reduction
description: Hydride transfer to an electrophilic carbonyl followed by protonation.

name: Catalytic Hydrogenation
description: Surface-mediated hydrogen addition to a reducible unsaturated bond.

name: Boc Deprotection
description: Acidic cleavage of a Boc carbamate.

name: Palladium Cross-Coupling
description: Catalytic cycle commonly involving oxidative addition, partner transfer and reductive elimination.

name: Mitsunobu Inversion
description: Activated alcohol undergoes nucleophilic displacement, commonly with inversion.
